raw.disclosing_quote: We collect information from and about you. [P2]
raw.generic_quote: We collect information from and about you. [P2]
raw.purpose_quote: We may share information with third parties. [P8] We will share information within the Live Nation family of companies. This may include Ticketmaster and Live Nation-owned or operated venues, for example. [P9] We will share information with third parties who perform services on our behalf. For example, we share information with vendors who help us manage our online registration process or who fulfill your purchases. Some vendors may be located outside of the United States. [P10] We may share information if we think we have to in order to comply with the law or to protect ourselves. For example, we will share information to respond to a court order or subpoena. We may also share it if a government agency or investigatory body requests. Or, we might also share information when we are investigating potential fraud. This might include fraud we think has happened during a sweepstakes or promotion. [P11] We may share information with any successor to all or part of our business. For example, if part of our business is sold we may give our customer list as part of that transaction. [P12]
raw.unspecified_purpose_quote: We may share your information for reasons not described in this policy. We will tell you before we do this. [P13]
raw.rationale: The policy discloses collecting computer information but does not specify a purpose for it, except for sharing with third parties and other unspecified purposes.
